I understand how disappointing this is, Amelia, and I truly wish I could offer a different outcome. If you truly can't do anything, then yes, transfer me to a human agent, but make sure they know I'm requesting at least a 10% refund or equivalent credit and that I'm prepared to escalate this further if needed.
I understand your position, Amelia. Let me transfer you to a human agent who can review your request.
